observation.productMessage: The File Repair feature is temporarily unavailable due to maintenance. Please use the desktop application to process your files.
observation.operatorNote: The maintenance state applied to the online file-repair path; no technical attempt or score is claimed.

accessConstraint.note: Repairit's primary online file page advertises PDF and Office formats but not ZIP; its desktop offer advertises ZIP. The unavailable page prevented an online upload attempt.
